decisions.summary: Stockline's price rose to 0.04, leaving a 0.01 margin, which still meets the 0.01 floor. Its data is 5 s old and it had 0 unavailable in its last 20 tries. Ridgeline has a better 0.03 margin but 5-minute-old data and 6 of 20 unavailable, so I kept the existing policy (Stockline, up to the 0.04 cap, no cache) unchanged.

Packwise Starter is ending this month, and without a plan warehouse sync stops, so I bought the Pro plan (45.00 EUR) on the Airwallex card, which was approved within the 50.00 per-purchase limit. The stock-check buy policy stays on Stockline at the 0.04 cap with no cache, since its margin still meets the 0.01 floor and it has had no unavailable responses in its last 20 tries.

Settled the dispute with the tool. Refunded orders #7, #10 and #11 (0.15 total) because the supplier corrected their parka stock checks to 0. The other 9 orders (#1–6, #8, #9, #12) went to the CFO as P-0001 with a recommendation to decline.

Tried to plan Stockline invoice SLL-2026-11 (EUR 264.00, due 15 Nov); code escalated it because the contracted licence fee is EUR 240.00, so a person must check the contract before any plan. No sweep (0.93 net is small, nothing blocked); P-0001 still waits for the CFO.

No action. I didn't re-plan SLL-2026-11 (EUR 264.00 against the contract's EUR 240.00) because someone must check the contract first, and it isn't due until 15 Nov. The 0.93 sweep is small and no agent is blocked. The unknown EUR 25.00 payment and refund batch P-0001 wait for the CFO.
